items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: We had -- Buck and Bubbles was with us.

ctx.x: What about the theater in Kansas City?

Oh, we go into Kansas City. We had played St. Louis. And it's an amazing thing. Ella was so popular -- the band was going over so big, you know. And Bill Beeson was still with the band. We did good in Chicago. We had a good show. We had -- Buck and Bubbles was with us. And some other people I can't recall. But we always had a good show -- really good show. Peg Leg Bates was one of the stars with us at one time. He always travelled with us, you know. In California, we had Buck and Bubbles, Nicholas Kids -- oh!…
travelling through -- we had to go into St. Louis. From St. Louis into Kansas City.
